label: Reconstructed 1835 workwear studies referenced to existing resident records
source_scope: Text terminology only. Nearby June/July 1835 advertisements mention shirts, vests, pantaloons and round jackets. The July 4 advertisement postdates July 1; source text does not attest an exact outfit or before-scene availability. No page pixels, photographic garment tracing or named likeness is used.
basis: Original garment shells fitted to the cleared anonymous adult base. Shirt, separate waistcoat, high-waisted trousers and closed shoes are a bounded reconstruction. Pattern/cut, seams, layer ease, colors, buttons, wear and body shape are unmeasured choices; not an attested uniform or photographic character.
material_limitations: Hash-verified CC0 reusable generic skin atlas is packed as sRGB with WHITE base-color factor; it does not attest a resident complexion or photographic likeness. Skin roughness is reconstructed. Shirt uses original deterministic 256x256 procedural weave; other surfaces remain flat original PBR colors. Final skin UV/LOD/export fidelity and photographic quality remain unaccepted.
validation_status: Builder not yet executed in Blender. Canonical blend, exports, anatomical fit, morphs, skinning, UV density and all CI renders remain unverified.
